answer_1.quote: we employ a transformer-based generative language model, i.e., GPT-2 , for TST and we train the model using REINFORCE algorithm. Specifically, the source sentence D is prompted to the GPT-2 model to generate the target sentence D′.
answer_1.outputs: generated sentences in the target style

answer_2.quote: we assess the performance of the models based on: (1) Style Strength (ACC)... (2) Content Preservation (BLEU)... (3) HM... (4) BLEURT... For the unsupervised setting we use: Style Transfer Accuracy (S-ACC), self-BLEU, ref-BLEU, BERT-P, BERT-R, BERT-F1, and Fluency (PPL).

answer_4.quote: we hire 4 annotators to rate model predictions from 1 (Very Bad) to 5 (Very Good) on content preservation, style conversion, and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated sentence on a 1‑5 scale for content preservation, style conversion, and fluency.
